description: Declaration record published at rkey 'self' to register an account as an evaluator service. Analogous to app.bsky.labeler.service for labelers.

evaluationTypeDefinition.description: Definition of a single evaluation type produced by this evaluator.

identifier.description: The evaluation type identifier (must match an entry in evaluationTypes).

locales.description: Human-readable names and descriptions in various languages.

method.description: Default method info for this evaluation type (can be overridden per-evaluation).

resultType.description: The lexicon reference for the result type (e.g., 'app.gainforest.evaluator.defs#speciesIdResult').

evaluationTypeLocale.description: Localized name and description for an evaluation type.

description.description: Longer description of what this evaluation type does.

name.description: Short human-readable name for this evaluation type.

evaluatorPolicies.description: Policies declaring what this evaluator does and how it operates.

accessModel.description: Whether this evaluator requires user subscription ('subscription') or processes all matching records ('open').

evaluationTypeDefinitions.description: Detailed definitions for each evaluation type, including human-readable descriptions.

evaluationTypes.description: List of evaluation type identifiers this evaluator produces (e.g., 'species-id', 'data-quality').

subjectCollections.description: NSIDs of record collections this evaluator can evaluate (e.g., 'app.gainforest.dwc.occurrence').

main.description: An evaluator service declaration. Publish at /app.gainforest.evaluator.service/self to declare this account as an evaluator.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when this evaluator service was declared.

policies.description: The evaluator's policies including supported evaluation types and access model.
